## `neuro.atomics.notify`

Static method on `Atomics`.

> Wakes up sleeping agents that are waiting on the given index of the array, returning the
> number of agents that were awoken.

## Signatures

```ts
notify(input: { typedArray: Int32Array; index: number; count?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
notify(input: { typedArray: BigInt64Array; index: number; count?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Atomics.notify` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
